bca_global_settings_expect_output_energy_cycle_mode = {
    potential = { exists = from from = { check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 0 } } }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_TARGET_MODE_TOOLTIP
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_energy_forbidden }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_economic_target_energy_forbidden
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_energy_unlimited }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_economic_target_energy_unlimited
                    set_country_flag = bca_economic_target_energy_forbidden
                }
                else = {
                    set_country_flag = bca_economic_target_energy_unlimited
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_global_settings_expect_output_trade_cycle_mode = {
    potential = { exists = from from = { check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 0 } } }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_TARGET_MODE_TOOLTIP
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_trade_forbidden }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_economic_target_trade_forbidden
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_economic_target_trade_unlimited }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_economic_target_trade_unlimited
                    set_country_flag = bca_economic_target_trade_forbidden
                }
                else = {
                    set_country_flag = bca_economic_target_trade_unlimited
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_global_settings_economic_tolerance_minus_10 = {
    potential = { exists = from from = { check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 0 } } }
    allow = {
        from = {
            has_country_flag = bca_enable_economic_management
        }
    }
    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_ECONOMIC_TOLERANCE_TOOLTIP
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = bca_economic_target_tolerance } }
                    set_variable = { which = bca_economic_target_tolerance value = 5 }
                }
                change_variable = { which = bca_economic_target_tolerance value = -10 }
                if = {
                    limit = { check_variable = { which = bca_economic_target_tolerance value < 0 } }
                    set_variable = { which = bca_economic_target_tolerance value = 0 }
                }
                bca_global_settings_recompute_economic_target_bounds = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
